reading_1.theme: Extracellular matrix collagen and elastic fibre assembly
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are collagen biosynthesis and fibril organisation together with elastic fibre assembly, i.e. building the structural fibres of the extracellular matrix that crosslinking then stabilises.

reading_2.theme: Extracellular matrix assembly: collagen, elastic fibres, basement membrane
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame collagen synthesis, fibril organization and elastic fibre assembly as the interstitial structural matrix, complemented by basement membrane, laminin and integrin anchoring.

shared: establishment or maintenance of cell polarity regulating cell shape

reading_1.theme: Actin remodeling for filopodia, polarity and adhesion
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover filopodium formation, cell polarity and postsynaptic actin organization downstream of EPHB and RHOF. This is protrusion control that connects to actin bundling and crosslinking and to integrin-ILK focal adhesion and spreading.

reading_2.theme: Actin cytoskeleton remodelling and cell shape
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are signalling control of actin protrusions, with filopodium assembly, RHOF and EPHB signalling, cell-polarity-driven shape and postsynaptic actin, which act on actin bundling, crosslinking and integrin/focal adhesion machinery.

shared: Activation of AMPK downstream of NMDARs
CREB1 phosphorylation through the activation of CaMKII/CaMKK/CaMKIV cascasde

reading_1.theme: Activity-dependent CaMK-CREB signalling in synaptic plasticity and memory
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame NMDA receptor-driven calcium/CaMK cascades to CREB and AMPK as the synapse-to-nucleus signalling that underlies long-term potentiation and memory.

reading_2.theme: NMDA receptor calcium signalling in synaptic plasticity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the Ca2+-activated CaMKK/CaMKIV/CaMKII and AMPK kinase relays that turn NMDA-receptor calcium influx into CREB phosphorylation and energy sensing, i.e. the nuclear, transcriptional output arm of glutamatergic long-term potentiation.

shared: obsolete neuron projection extension involved in neuron projection guidance
negative regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance
positive regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance

reading_1.theme: Axon guidance by attractive and repulsive cues
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover repulsive regulation of axon extension, chiefly Sema3A chemorepulsion. This is one guidance system among netrin/DCC, ephrin, Slit-Robo, DSCAM and L1-CAM cues that steer and bundle axons.

reading_2.theme: Axon guidance by repulsive and attractive cues
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the growth-cone outputs of guidance, semaphorin-driven repulsion and positive or negative control of axon extension, on which netrin, ephrin, Slit-Robo and L1 signalling converge.

shared: host-mediated suppression of viral genome replication
clearance of foreign intracellular nucleic acids
negative regulation of single stranded viral RNA replication via double stranded DNA intermediate

reading_1.theme: Nucleic acid base editing and demethylation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are APOBEC cytidine deamination used as antiviral restriction of viral genomes, within the broader theme of enzymatic base editing (ADAR) and DNA demethylation/alkylation reversal.

reading_2.theme: Nucleic acid editing, deamination and demethylation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are APOBEC cytidine deamination used as antiviral restriction, with C-to-U editing of foreign nucleic acids, suppression of viral (retroviral) replication, and its counteraction by HIV Vif, within a broader set of base-modifying enzymes for A-to-I editing, DNA demethylation and alkylation damage reversal.

shared: Negative feedback regulation of MAPK pathway
negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction
negative regulation of ERK1 and ERK2 cascade

reading_1.theme: RAS-RAF-MAPK signalling and its feedback regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the negative-feedback and attenuation arm of the ERK cascade (RSK activation, phosphatase dephosphorylation, inhibition of Ras and ERK signalling), counterbalancing the RAF activation and oncogenic RAS/MAP2K/NF1 mutant signalling.

reading_2.theme: RAS-MAPK signalling and its negative feedback
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe negative feedback on RAS-ERK signalling (phosphatases, RSK, Ras inhibition), framed as the brake on a cascade driven by oncogenic RAS, RAF and MAP2K mutants.

shared: RORA,B,C and NR1D1 (REV-ERBA) regulate gene expression
NPAS4 regulates expression of target genes
Expression of BMAL (ARNTL), CLOCK, and NPAS2

reading_1.theme: Nuclear receptor and circadian control of metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover PPAR, thyroid and ROR/REV-ERB nuclear receptors, PGC-1alpha and the BMAL1-CLOCK circadian clock, framed as transcriptional regulation of metabolism and mitochondrial biogenesis.

reading_2.theme: Circadian clock control of metabolic nuclear-receptor transcription
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame the BMAL1/CLOCK and ROR/REV-ERB loop together with PPARA, PGC-1alpha and other nuclear receptors as the transcriptional output linking the circadian clock to lipid metabolism and mitochondrial biogenesis.

shared: enriched in naive and memory B cells

reading_1.theme: B cell development, activation and proliferation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are generic lymphocyte and naive/memory B cell expression modules, framed as the identity signature underlying B cell differentiation and proliferation.

reading_2.theme: B cell development, activation and proliferation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are lymphocyte and B cell transcriptional modules for development and activation, read here as markers of the B lineage whose differentiation and proliferation in immune responses the additional terms specify.

shared: negative regulation of D-glucose import across plasma membrane
positive regulation of D-glucose import across plasma membrane
positive regulation of cellular response to insulin stimulus

reading_1.theme: Insulin- and adiponectin-regulated glucose uptake
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe adiponectin signalling and regulation of glucose import and insulin sensitivity, framed as control of insulin-stimulated GLUT4-mediated glucose uptake.

reading_2.theme: Insulin and adipokine control of glucose and lipid metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are insulin sensitivity, adiponectin signalling and glucose import into cells, framed as the output layer of hormonal (insulin/IGF, glucagon/PKA, AMPK) regulation of systemic fuel storage and use.

reading_1.theme: GABA neurotransmitter metabolism and transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover GABA synthesis and its reuptake into cells, forming the production-and-recycling half of the GABA life cycle completed by its secretion and degradation.

reading_2.theme: GABA synthesis, transport and degradation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover GABA synthesis and reuptake/import, the neurotransmitter supply and recycling half of a GABA life cycle completed by its secretion and degradation.

shared: negative regulation of ERK1 and ERK2 cascade
negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction
SHOC2 M1731 mutant abolishes MRAS complex function
Negative feedback regulation of MAPK pathway
Gain-of-function MRAS complexes activate RAF signaling

reading_1.theme: RAS-RAF-ERK MAPK signalling and negative feedback
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are RAF/ERK activation and its phosphatase-mediated negative feedback, including RASopathy-associated MRAS/SHOC2 and MAP2K mutants, as the core control loop of MAPK signalling.

reading_2.theme: RAS-RAF-MAPK signalling downstream of FGFRs and oncogenic mutants
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are RAF/ERK activation and its negative feedback, framed as the common intracellular cascade downstream of FGFR signalling and mutated RAS/RAF/BRAF.

shared: negative regulation of amyloid precursor protein catabolic process
obsolete negative regulation of amide metabolic process
obsolete positive regulation of amide metabolic process
obsolete regulation of amide metabolic process
negative regulation of amyloid precursor protein biosynthetic process
negative regulation of amyloid fibril formation
amyloid-beta clearance by cellular catabolic process
positive regulation of amyloid fibril formation

reading_1.theme: Amyloid-beta handling and microglial neuroinflammation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe amyloid-beta production, fibril formation and clearance, framed as the substrate of Alzheimer-type pathology handled by microglial activation, lysosomal clearance and glial responses.

reading_2.theme: Amyloid-beta production, aggregation and clearance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe APP processing control, amyloid fibril formation and amyloid-beta clearance, framed here with endosomal trafficking as the compartment where APP and amyloid-beta are handled.

shared: cyclic-GMP-AMP transmembrane import across plasma membrane
positive regulation of cGAS/STING signaling pathway
positive regulation of dendritic cell cytokine production

reading_1.theme: cGAS-STING sensing and dendritic cell cytokine responses
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover STING pathway activation, including import of extracellular cGAMP, and the resulting cytokine production by myeloid dendritic cells. Here this is innate antimicrobial signalling linked to CCL5 chemokine regulation, GBP-mediated defense and inflammasome activity.

reading_2.theme: Nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon antiviral signalling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame cGAMP import and cGAS-STING-driven dendritic cell cytokine production as the cytosolic DNA-sensing arm of antiviral innate immunity, alongside endosomal TLR7/8/9 sensing, interferon regulation and RNA editing.

shared: double-strand break repair via break-induced replication
protection from non-homologous end joining at telomere

reading_1.theme: Telomere maintenance via replication and recombination repair
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover telomere replication, capping, t-loop/D-loop handling and break-induced replication, framed as telomere-specific uses of the helicase, strand-invasion and DSB repair machinery.

reading_2.theme: Telomere maintenance by recombination and replication
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover telomere capping, D-loop and t-circle handling, break-induced replication and recombination-based maintenance, framed as telomere end protection and replication with links to recombination checkpoints in mitosis.

reading_1.theme: Lysosomal glycoconjugate catabolism and amino sugar metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe lysosomal breakdown of gangliosides and glycosides and its storage diseases, framed alongside sialic acid, amino sugar and nucleotide-sugar metabolism that supply and recycle glycan building blocks.

reading_2.theme: Glycosphingolipid and ganglioside metabolism and lysosomal storage
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are lysosomal degradation of gangliosides and glycosphingolipids and its storage diseases (GM2 gangliosidoses, sialidosis), framed as the catabolic half of glycolipid turnover opposite their biosynthesis and GPI-anchor lipid processing.

shared: Erythrocytes take up carbon dioxide and release oxygen
Defective RHAG causes regulator type Rh-null hemolytic anemia (RHN)
Erythrocytes take up oxygen and release carbon dioxide

reading_1.theme: Erythrocyte gas exchange and ammonium/CO2 transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover erythrocyte membrane and hemoglobin transport of oxygen, CO2, NO and ammonia, including through Rh/RHAG glycoproteins. Here this is respiratory gas and acid-base exchange, supported by carbonic anhydrase and lactate/MCT-basigin transport.

reading_2.theme: Erythrocyte gas transport with heme and iron metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are red-cell membrane transport functions (O2/CO2 exchange, Rh-mediated ammonium transport), framed as mature erythrocyte function supported by heme synthesis, iron supply and erythroid differentiation.

reading_1.theme: Oxidative and hypoxic stress responses and cell death
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the sensing of oxidative and hypoxic insults (H2O2, hydroperoxides, H2S, ischemia, oxygen), which the theme links to regulation of stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis.

reading_2.theme: Oxidative stress responses and cell death
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cellular responses to peroxides, ischemia and oxygen stress, the oxidative insult that triggers or is countered by regulation of intrinsic apoptosis.

shared: Enhanced cleavage of VWF variant by ADAMTS13
Defective VWF cleavage by ADAMTS13 variant
Defective VWF binding to collagen type I
Enhanced binding of GP1BA variant to VWF multimer:collagen
Defective binding of VWF variant to GPIb:IX:V

reading_1.theme: Hemostasis: VWF-platelet adhesion, coagulation and fibrinolysis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are von Willebrand factor-mediated primary hemostasis (VWF binding to GPIb and collagen, ADAMTS13 cleavage) and its disease variants, coupled to the coagulation factor cascade and fibrinolysis.

reading_2.theme: VWF-mediated platelet adhesion, activation and hemostasis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame VWF binding to collagen and GPIb-IX-V and its ADAMTS13 cleavage (with disease variants) as the primary hemostatic adhesion step that triggers platelet activation, degranulation and coagulation.

shared: regulation of mitochondrial RNA catabolic process
FASTK family proteins regulate processing and stability of mitochondrial RNAs

reading_1.theme: Mitochondrial gene expression from RNA processing to translation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover mitochondrial mRNA modification, FASTK-mediated processing and stability, RNA decay control and large mitoribosome assembly. This is the post-transcriptional machinery enabling mitochondrial translation, alongside mtDNA replication.

reading_2.theme: Mitochondrial gene expression: RNA processing and translation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are mitochondrial mRNA processing, modification and stability plus mitoribosome large-subunit assembly, the post-transcriptional steps linking mtDNA expression to mitochondrial translation.

shared: positive regulation of natural killer cell differentiation
regulation of natural killer cell proliferation

reading_1.theme: Cytokine signalling regulating NK and lymphocyte responses
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover IL-15 and IL-21 common gamma-chain cytokine signalling driving NK cell proliferation and differentiation. This sits within a broader cytokine network (IL-10, IL-12/23/27, IL-20 family, interferons) shaping NK/NKT activation and inflammation.

reading_2.theme: Common gamma-chain cytokine signalling in NK and T cells
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are IL-15 and IL-21 signalling driving NK cell differentiation and proliferation, framed as the NK-cell arm of common gamma-chain/JAK-STAT cytokine signalling whose T-cell arm is IL-2 and IL-7.

shared: negative regulation of protein targeting to membrane
regulation of endosome to plasma membrane protein transport
regulation of Rab protein signal transduction

reading_1.theme: Rab-regulated endosomal recycling and membrane trafficking
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe Rab/TBC-regulated endocytic and receptor recycling and endosome organisation, framed as membrane trafficking that also involves tubulation and ARF-dependent Golgi budding.

reading_2.theme: Golgi, endosome and lysosome vesicular trafficking
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Rab-GTPase-regulated endocytic recycling, endosome organization and constitutive secretion, framed as the receptor recycling and secretion branch of the Golgi-endosome-lysosome sorting network.

shared: Loss of Function of KMT2D in MLL4 Complex Formation in Kabuki Syndrome

reading_1.theme: Histone lysine methylation and acetylation in chromatin regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame the WDR5/KMT2 (MLL4) histone methyltransferase complexes as the methylation arm of chromatin writing, paired with acetyltransferase activity on histones and other proteins.

reading_2.theme: Epigenetic chromatin regulation by histone and DNA methylation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the WDR5/MLL (KMT2D) histone lysine methyltransferase complexes, which are disrupted in Kabuki syndrome. They are the histone-methylation writer arm within a wider epigenetic programme that also includes repressive heterochromatin, DNA methylation, imprinting, X inactivation and retroelement silencing.

shared: negative regulation of CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell activation
negative regulation of activated T cell proliferation
negative regulation of CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell proliferation
negative regulation of type II interferon production
negative regulation of T-helper 17 cell lineage commitment
negative regulation of T cell cytokine production
positive regulation of regulatory T cell differentiation
regulation of CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell differentiation

reading_1.theme: Immune tolerance through T cell suppression and Treg induction
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe negative regulation of effector T cell activation, proliferation and cytokine/IFN-gamma production together with promotion of regulatory T cell differentiation, i.e. the inhibitory immune-checkpoint arm acting on TCR engagement and co-stimulation by antigen-presenting cells.

reading_2.theme: Regulatory T cell-mediated suppression of T cell responses
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the suppression of effector T cell activation, proliferation and IFN-gamma/Th17 output together with induction of regulatory T cells, i.e. the tolerance arm of T cell costimulatory regulation.

reading_1.theme: Selective autophagy clearing misfolded protein aggregates
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the autophagy routes (aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated, microautophagy, nutrient-responsive autophagy) framed as the degradation machinery that clears aggresome-sequestered misfolded proteins.

reading_2.theme: Selective autophagy pathways
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are non-macroautophagic and selective degradation routes (chaperone-mediated autophagy, microautophagy, aggrephagy) plus ATG8 delipidation and nutrient sensing, framed as the core autophagy machinery alongside organelle-selective autophagy.

shared: negative regulation of T-helper 17 cell lineage commitment
negative regulation of activated T cell proliferation
negative regulation of type II interferon production
negative regulation of CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell proliferation
negative regulation of CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell activation
positive regulation of CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell proliferation
regulation of CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell differentiation
negative regulation of T cell cytokine production
positive regulation of regulatory T cell differentiation

reading_1.theme: Regulation of T cell activation, tolerance and Treg differentiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe the balance of T cell proliferation versus suppression, mainly inhibition of effector CD4/CD8 responses, Th17 commitment and IFN-gamma production with induction of regulatory T cells, set within APC-dependent TCR engagement and co-stimulation.

reading_2.theme: Regulatory T cell-mediated suppression of T cell activation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe induction of Tregs and dampening of CD4/CD8 proliferation, IFN-gamma and Th17 commitment, framed as immunosuppression delivered through costimulatory and antigen-presenting cell contact.

shared: negative regulation of MHC class II biosynthetic process
T cell antigen processing and presentation
Gene and protein expression by JAK-STAT signaling after Interleukin-12 stimulation

reading_1.theme: IL-12 and IFN-gamma driven Th1 immunity
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are antigen presentation and IL-12/JAK-STAT signalling, serving as the antigen-presenting-cell-to-T-cell priming inputs that drive Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma-regulated MHC expression.

reading_2.theme: IFN-gamma, IL-12 and Th1-driven antigen presentation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are IL-12/JAK-STAT signalling and T cell antigen presentation with MHC class II regulation, framed as the Th1 axis in which IL-12 drives IFN-gamma, which in turn controls MHC expression, cytotoxic T cell expansion and allograft-type responses.

shared: positive regulation of myeloid leukocyte mediated immunity

reading_1.theme: Neutrophil and myeloid innate antimicrobial defence
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover myeloid inflammatory activation and neutrophil degranulation, framed as phagocyte antimicrobial effector function including respiratory burst and killing of bacteria and fungi.

reading_2.theme: Myeloid inflammatory activation and neutrophil degranulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the generic myeloid inflammatory effector response, neutrophil degranulation, complement and TLR signalling, of monocytes and neutrophils.

shared: regulation of branching involved in ureteric bud morphogenesis
positive regulation of epithelial tube formation
metanephric part of ureteric bud development

reading_1.theme: Kidney organogenesis: ureteric bud branching and nephron patterning
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways capture the early inductive events (intermediate mesoderm, ureteric bud elongation and branching, renal vesicle formation) that precede nephron segmentation and collecting duct, loop of Henle and S-shaped body morphogenesis.

reading_2.theme: Kidney development: ureteric bud and metanephric nephrogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, ureteric bud branching and metanephric mesenchyme differentiation, framed here as the reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal induction that builds nephrons and the collecting system.

shared: regulation of NK T cell differentiation
regulation of NK T cell proliferation
positive regulation of NK T cell activation

reading_1.theme: NKT and NK cell development and cytokine-driven activation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover NKT cell differentiation, proliferation and activation, which this theme frames as one arm of innate-like lymphocyte expansion driven by IL-15 and IL-21 cytokine signalling shared with NK and T cells.

reading_2.theme: IL-12-driven Th1 and NKT cell immunity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are NK T cell differentiation, proliferation and activation, framed as an innate-like lymphocyte arm of the IL-12/IFN-gamma Th1 response initiated by activated dendritic cells.

shared: arachidonate metabolite production involved in inflammatory response
Biosynthesis of protectin and resolvin conjugates in tissue regeneration (PCTR and RCTR)
Biosynthesis of maresin conjugates in tissue regeneration (MCTR)
Biosynthesis of electrophilic ω-3 PUFA oxo-derivatives

reading_1.theme: Specialized pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the lipoxygenase-driven oxygenation of arachidonate and omega-3 PUFAs (lipoxins, 5-/15-HETE derivatives, electrophilic oxo-derivatives, maresin/protectin/resolvin conjugates), framed as precursor branches of the mediators that resolve inflammation and promote tissue regeneration.

reading_2.theme: Biosynthesis of specialized pro-resolving lipid mediators
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are lipoxygenase-derived eicosanoid and lipoxin synthesis and early SPM conjugates, framed here as the pro-resolving branch of inflammatory lipid metabolism together with resolvins, protectins and maresins from omega-3 fatty acids.

shared: attachment of GPI anchor to protein
obsolete protein N-linked glycosylation via asparagine

reading_1.theme: Dolichol-linked N-glycan and GPI anchor synthesis, CDG disorders
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the sugar-donor and lipid-carrier supply for ER glycosylation, with UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucose and dolichyl-phosphate synthesis and early lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly, framed through the congenital disorders of glycosylation and myasthenic syndromes their defects cause.

reading_2.theme: Dolichol pathway and N-linked glycosylation with CDGs
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are dolichyl-phosphate and nucleotide-sugar synthesis and lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly, framed as the early N-glycosylation steps whose defects cause congenital disorders of glycosylation.

shared: Ribosome Quality Control (RQC) complex extracts and degrades nascent peptide
nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, no-go decay
ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the C-end degron rule pathway
ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the N-end rule pathway
tRNA-type intron splice site recognition and cleavage
ZNF598 and the Ribosome-associated Quality Trigger (RQT) complex dissociate a ribosome stalled on a no-go mRNA
negative regulation of nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, nonsense-mediated decay
PELO:HBS1L and ABCE1 dissociate a ribosome on a non-stop mRNA
Nonsense Mediated Decay (NMD) independent of the Exon Junction Complex (EJC)
Nonsense Mediated Decay (NMD) enhanced by the Exon Junction Complex (EJC)

reading_1.theme: RNA processing, surveillance and decay
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are cytoplasmic translational quality control and RNA decay (NMD, ribosome rescue, RQC and degron-mediated protein disposal), the surveillance end of an RNA life cycle that includes nuclear transcription, splicing, 3'-end processing and export.

reading_2.theme: RNA processing, surveillance and decay
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the quality-control and turnover end of RNA metabolism, with nonsense-, non-stop- and no-go mRNA decay, stalled-ribosome rescue and nascent-peptide degradation, translation termination, and rRNA, tRNA and pre-mRNA catabolism, set against the nuclear splicing, 3'-end processing, snRNA biogenesis and export machinery in the additional set.

shared: negative regulation of neuron projection regeneration
positive regulation of neuron projection regeneration

reading_1.theme: Axon regeneration and growth control
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are sprouting and regeneration of injured axons and their positive/negative regulation, framed as the outcome balanced by growth-stimulating versus RhoA- and ceramide-mediated inhibitory signalling.

reading_2.theme: Axon regeneration and growth control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are axon regrowth after injury and its positive and negative regulation, which the additional terms explain through growth-stimulating and RHOA/ceramide-mediated growth-inhibitory neuronal signalling.

shared: [untitled BTM module] This grouping describes lymphocyte activation within organised lymphoid tissue, the process by which antigen-experienced B and T cells are positioned, co-stimulated and driven toward antibody secretion. It underlies germinal centre reactions and the generation of plasma cells, and its components are the surface markers used to identify activated and malignant lymphoid cells.
positive regulation of B cell receptor signaling pathway
enriched in naive and memory B cells

reading_1.theme: B lymphocyte identity and activation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are B cell receptor signalling and B-lymphocyte transcriptional modules framed as lymphoid activation, set within the broader naive, memory and plasma cell B cell surface signatures.

reading_2.theme: B cell identity and B cell receptor activation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are B cell gene signatures and BCR signalling positive regulation, framed as the mature/naive B cell identity and antigen-receptor activation programme leading toward plasma cell differentiation.

shared: obsolete glutamine family amino acid metabolic process

reading_1.theme: Proline, ornithine and arginine/urea-cycle amino acid metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover glutamate-family amino acid interconversion: proline synthesis and catabolism, and citrulline metabolism. Through ornithine these link to arginine catabolism, the urea cycle and cationic amino acid transport (SLC7A7, SLC25A15).

reading_2.theme: Amino acid metabolism, biosynthesis and catabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the glutamate/proline/citrulline (glutamine-family) branch of amino acid metabolism, framed as one sector of broad amino acid interconversion alongside sulfur, aromatic, serine/threonine and vitamin B6-dependent pathways.

shared: SEMA3A-Plexin repulsion signaling by inhibiting Integrin adhesion

reading_1.theme: Semaphorin-mediated axon guidance and sprouting
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are Sema3A-plexin repulsion and semaphorin interactions in axonogenesis and sympathetic innervation, framed as the guidance signals controlling axon extension and collateral sprouting.

reading_2.theme: Repulsive axon guidance and neuronal projection wiring
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Sema3A/plexin signalling via CRMPs, PAK and integrin inhibition driving axon guidance and innervation, framed here as one repulsive-cue system alongside ephrin and L1-family cues that shape growth cone collapse, fasciculation and neuron remodelling.

shared: Uptake and function of anthrax toxins
Uptake and function of diphtheria toxin

reading_1.theme: Bacterial toxins and pathogen-host interaction
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are host responses to microbial products, covering diphtheria and anthrax toxin uptake, NADPH oxidase activation, anti-inflammatory CD163 and pathogen-specific responses, set beside bacterial attachment and entry into host cells.

reading_2.theme: Host-pathogen interactions and bacterial toxin entry
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover bacterial toxin uptake, anti-infective/anti-inflammatory host responses and NADPH oxidase activation, framed as host-pathogen interaction alongside bacterial attachment and invasion of host cells.

reading_1.theme: TGFBR3 co-receptor regulation of TGF-beta superfamily signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe betaglycan (TGFBR3) modulation of TGF-beta and FGF2 signalling and its post-translational regulation, framed as co-receptor gating of growth-factor signalling extending to activin and its antagonism by follistatin.

reading_2.theme: Regulation of TGF-beta receptor and SMAD signalling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe betaglycan (TGFBR3) as a co-receptor that presents or sequesters ligands for TGF-beta and FGF2 receptors, so they act as an upstream modulator setting the strength of SMAD signalling.

shared: regulation of barbed-end actin filament capping
positive regulation of actin filament depolymerization
negative regulation of Arp2/3 complex-mediated actin nucleation
establishment or maintenance of cell polarity regulating cell shape

reading_1.theme: Rho GTPase-driven actin remodelling for cell migration
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the actin filament architecture controls (crosslinking, severing, capping, bundling, network formation, restraint of Arp2/3 nucleation) that serve as the cytoskeletal effector machinery Rho-family GTPases tune to build protrusions, set cell shape and polarity, and drive cell motility.

reading_2.theme: Rho GTPase-driven actin remodeling in cell migration
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover actin filament structural dynamics (severing, capping, depolymerization, bundling, crosslinking, network formation). They form the cytoskeletal effector layer that Rho-family GTPases (RAC, CDC42, RHOA and others) direct to build lamellipodia, ruffles and motile protrusions.

reading_1.theme: Glutamate, aspartate and nitrogen metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate, glutamine and aspartate interconversions for nitrogen utilization, framed as the amino acid nitrogen core linked to ammonium homeostasis, the malate-aspartate shuttle and creatine metabolism.

reading_2.theme: Glutamate-aspartate nitrogen metabolism and ammonia handling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover glutamate, glutamine and aspartate interconversion as the main nitrogen carriers. Here they feed ammonium homeostasis, NADH transfer by the malate-aspartate shuttle, and creatine synthesis.

shared: myeloid cell enriched receptors and transporters

reading_1.theme: Immune cell-type surface marker signatures
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are monocyte, dendritic cell and antigen-presentation surface signatures, framed as myeloid antigen-presenting-cell identity markers contrasted with B cell surface signatures.

reading_2.theme: Dendritic cell and monocyte surface antigen-presentation signatures
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are surface marker signatures of dendritic cells and monocytes, framed as antigen-presenting cell identity and differentiation.

shared: enriched in naive and memory B cells

[untitled BTM module] This grouping describes lymphocyte activation within organised lymphoid tissue, the process by which antigen-experienced B and T cells are positioned, co-stimulated and driven toward antibody secretion. It underlies germinal centre reactions and the generation of plasma cells, and its components are the surface markers used to identify activated and malignant lymphoid cells.
positive regulation of B cell receptor signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: B cell activation and germinal centre responses
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are B cell/lymphocyte signatures and BCR signalling, framed as the starting B cell state that is driven, with T follicular help and costimulation, into proliferation, germinal centre differentiation and humoral memory.

reading_2.theme: B cell identity and B cell receptor activation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are B cell gene signatures and BCR signalling positive regulation, framed as the mature/naive B cell identity and antigen-receptor activation programme leading toward plasma cell differentiation.

reading_1.theme: Cellular response to toxic heavy metals
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover cadmium and mercury detoxification and transport, framed as the core of a general cellular defence against toxic metal ions including cobalt, lead and selenium.

reading_2.theme: Heavy metal and zinc homeostasis and detoxification
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe cadmium and mercury transport and detoxification, framed as toxic-metal handling through the same zinc transporter, metallothionein and MTF1 machinery that maintains zinc homeostasis.

shared: Regulation of CDH11 mRNA translation by microRNAs
Regulation of CDH1 mRNA translation by microRNAs
positive regulation of miRNA catabolic process

reading_1.theme: MicroRNA biogenesis and post-transcriptional gene silencing
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are specific instances of miRNA control (pre-miRNA processing, miRNA turnover, miRNA repression of particular mRNAs such as CDH1, CDH11, PD-L1), framed as targets and regulation of the general small-RNA silencing machinery.

reading_2.theme: miRNA-mediated post-transcriptional gene silencing
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are control of miRNA processing and turnover and miRNA regulation of specific mRNA translation (CDH1, CDH11, NPAS4, PD-L1), the regulatory and target-level layer of small-RNA silencing.

shared: obsolete glutamine family amino acid metabolic process

reading_1.theme: Glutamate-centred amino acid and organic acid metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate/glutamine, proline and aspartate metabolism around 2-oxoglutarate, framed here as the nitrogen-handling hub of amino acid metabolism linked to glycine/glyoxylate metabolism and glycine/glutamine conjugation of xenobiotic acids.

reading_2.theme: Glutamate-centred amino acid and organic acid metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the glutamate/glutamine/2-oxoglutarate nitrogen hub (with proline and aspartate interconversions), serving as the central amino-nitrogen node that feeds glycine, glyoxylate and dicarboxylate metabolism and glutamine/glycine conjugation of xenobiotic acids.

reading_1.theme: Osmoregulation and renal chloride-coupled ion transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe cellular osmotic responses and transepithelial Na+/Cl- transport in the kidney, framed here as cation-chloride cotransporter function whose defects cause Bartter and Gitelman syndromes.

reading_2.theme: Renal salt transport and osmotic regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are renal sodium/chloride transport and cellular osmotic volume responses, implemented by SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters and potassium channels whose defects cause Bartter and Gitelman syndromes.

shared: Defective SLC5A7 in the neurotransmitter release cycle causes distal hereditary motor neuronopathy 7A (HMN7A)
Defective transport by SLC5A7 causes distal hereditary motor neuronopathy 7A (HMN7A)
positive regulation of synaptic transmission, cholinergic

reading_1.theme: Cholinergic neurotransmission at the neuromuscular junction
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover presynaptic choline uptake (SLC5A7/CHT1, including its motor neuronopathy defects) and acetylcholine synthesis and release. This is the presynaptic side of cholinergic transmission onto nicotinic receptors.

reading_2.theme: Cholinergic neuromuscular synaptic transmission
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the presynaptic cholinergic arm: high-affinity choline uptake by SLC5A7, acetylcholine synthesis and acetylcholine release (with SLC5A7 defects causing motor neuronopathy). Together these supply transmitter to the postsynaptic nicotinic acetylcholine receptors.

shared: obsolete glutamine family amino acid metabolic process

reading_1.theme: Proline, ornithine and arginine metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are glutamine-family amino acid metabolism, meaning proline synthesis and catabolism and citrulline metabolism, linked through ornithine to arginine catabolism, urea cycle regulation and cationic amino acid transport defects.

reading_2.theme: Proline, ornithine and arginine/urea-cycle amino acid metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover glutamate-family amino acid interconversion: proline synthesis and catabolism, and citrulline metabolism. Through ornithine these link to arginine catabolism, the urea cycle and cationic amino acid transport (SLC7A7, SLC25A15).

shared: positive regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome

reading_1.theme: Pre-mRNA processing: splicing, 3'-end maturation and export
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover snRNP biogenesis, cap hypermethylation, snRNA transport and spliceosome function. This is the splicing stage of an mRNA maturation pipeline that continues with 3'-end processing and nuclear export.

reading_2.theme: snRNP biogenesis and pre-mRNA processing and export
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover snRNP assembly, snRNA cap hypermethylation and transport and splicing, framed as the spliceosome machinery within broader mRNA processing, 3'-end formation and nuclear export.

shared: [untitled BTM module] These genes converge on integrin-based adhesion and the cytoskeletal signalling that lets cells grip and respond to their extracellular matrix, with a supporting cast of metabolic and gene-regulatory proteins. Talin links activated integrin tails to actin, integrin-linked kinase couples the adhesion complex to downstream survival and contractility signalling, and a Rho GDP-dissociation inhibitor restrains Rho-family GTPases so that actin remodelling is switched rather than constant; a microtubule-associated protein and the SNARE-recycling factor alpha-SNAP tie the same events to cytoskeletal turnover and membrane fusion.

reading_1.theme: Platelet activation, degranulation and cytoskeletal signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover platelet activation, SNARE-dependent granule secretion and integrin-actin cytoskeletal remodelling, framed as the effector response of platelets triggered by thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signalling.

reading_2.theme: Platelet activation and degranulation via integrin signalling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are platelet activation, degranulation, SNARE disinhibition and cytoskeletal remodeling, framed as the hemostatic platelet response driven by integrin-Rap1 adhesion signalling.

shared: Gain-of-function MRAS complexes activate RAF signaling
SHOC2 M1731 mutant abolishes MRAS complex function
negative regulation of ERK1 and ERK2 cascade
negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction
Negative feedback regulation of MAPK pathway

reading_1.theme: RAS-RAF-ERK MAPK signalling and negative feedback
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are RAF/ERK activation and its phosphatase-mediated negative feedback, including RASopathy-associated MRAS/SHOC2 and MAP2K mutants, as the core control loop of MAPK signalling.

reading_2.theme: RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signalling and its negative feedback
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover RAF/ERK activation (including MRAS-SHOC2 and oncogenic MAP2K mutants) together with phosphatase-mediated ERK inactivation and feedback. This is the tunable core of MAPK signalling, whose output includes AP-1 activation.

shared: Defective SLC35C1 causes congenital disorder of glycosylation 2C (CDG2C)
Defective SLC35A1 in sialic acid metabolism causes congenital disorder of glycosylation 2F (CDG2F)
Defective transport by SLC35A1 causes congenital disorder of glycosylation 2F (CDG2F)

reading_1.theme: Golgi nucleotide-sugar transporter defects in glycosylation disorders
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are SLC35A1/SLC35C1 defects causing CDG2F and CDG2C, framed as failures of the Golgi nucleotide-sugar transport needed for glycosylation.

reading_2.theme: Nucleotide-sugar supply for glycosylation: sialic acid and fucose
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame Golgi nucleotide-sugar transporters for CMP-sialic acid and GDP-fucose, whose defects cause congenital glycosylation disorders, as the delivery step for sugar donors made by GDP-fucose biosynthesis.

shared: antigen processing and presentation, endogenous lipid antigen via MHC class Ib

reading_1.theme: Antigen processing and presentation by MHC molecules
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are general and MHC class I/Ib antigen presentation (including lipid antigens), complemented by MHC class II presentation of exogenous peptides in B cells.

reading_2.theme: Dendritic cell antigen presentation including CD1 lipids and TLR7/8
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame MHC and CD1 lipid antigen presentation, co-expressed with endosomal TLR7/8, as the antigen-presenting function of dendritic cells.

Regulation of CDH11 mRNA translation by microRNAs
Regulation of CDH1 mRNA translation by microRNAs

reading_1.theme: MicroRNA biogenesis and post-transcriptional gene silencing
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are specific instances of miRNA control (pre-miRNA processing, miRNA turnover, miRNA repression of particular mRNAs such as CDH1, CDH11, PD-L1), framed as targets and regulation of the general small-RNA silencing machinery.

reading_2.theme: microRNA biogenesis, turnover and translational control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe pre-miRNA processing, target-directed miRNA decay and miRNA regulation of specific mRNAs (CDH1, CDH11, NPAS4, PD-L1), framed here as the effector and turnover end of the miRNA pathway whose primary and precursor processing steps are the additional set.

reading_1.theme: tRNA and protein modifications supporting translational fidelity
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are tRNA anticodon modifications and aminoacylation ensuring decoding fidelity, alongside wybutosine, diphthamide and protein hydroxylation modifications of translation components.

reading_2.theme: tRNA modification and aminoacylation for translational fidelity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are anticodon modifications and cytosolic aminoacylation, framed as maintaining decoding accuracy, the same fidelity function served by mitochondrial tRNA charging and wobble uridine thiolation.

shared: positive regulation of hemoglobin biosynthetic process

reading_1.theme: Mitochondrial heme and iron-sulfur cofactor biosynthesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are heme and Fe-S cluster biosynthesis, framed as mitochondrial cofactor production coupled to the TCA cycle that supplies succinyl-CoA and uses Fe-S enzymes.

reading_2.theme: Erythroid heme synthesis, iron handling and gas transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are heme biosynthesis and Fe-S cluster assembly, framed as supplying heme for hemoglobin during erythropoiesis within iron uptake, heme scavenging and oxygen/CO2 transport.

shared: Defective Inhibition of DNA Recombination at Telomere Due to ATRX Mutations
Inhibition of DNA recombination at telomere
protein localization to chromosome, telomeric region
Defective Inhibition of DNA Recombination at Telomere Due to DAXX Mutations

protection from non-homologous end joining at telomere

reading_1.theme: Telomere end protection and maintenance
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover the protected telomere state: capping, chromatin packaging, blocking NHEJ and t-circles, restraining telomerase, and ATRX/DAXX-dependent suppression of recombination. This state sits beside telomerase extension and C-strand synthesis.

reading_2.theme: Telomere protection and telomerase-dependent maintenance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are telomere capping and protection (shelterin-type end protection, blocking NHEJ and recombination/ALT via ATRX-DAXX, restraint of telomerase), which here forms the protective counterpart to telomerase recruitment and C-strand fill-in that lengthen telomeres.

reading_1.theme: Vitamin K, quinone metabolism and gamma-carboxylation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe the metabolism of vitamin K and related quinones (menaquinone, ubiquinol), which here serves as the cofactor supply for gamma-carboxylation of coagulation proteins.

reading_2.theme: Vitamin K metabolism and protein gamma-carboxylation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover quinone metabolism (vitamin K/menaquinone and ubiquinol synthesis and catabolism). Here they supply the vitamin K cofactor that gamma-carboxylates clotting factor precursors, next to fat-soluble vitamin E transport.

shared: negative regulation of nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, deadenylation-dependent decay
Insulin-like Growth Factor-2 mRNA Binding Proteins (IGF2BPs/IMPs/VICKZs) bind RNA
positive regulation of cytoplasmic mRNA processing body assembly

reading_1.theme: Post-transcriptional control by RNA-binding proteins and miRNAs
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are IGF2BP-mediated mRNA stabilization, P-body assembly and translation promotion, framed as mRNA stability and translation control counterpart to small-RNA silencing.

reading_2.theme: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and decay
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover mRNA stabilization by RNA-binding proteins (IGF2BP, CRD-mediated) and promotion of cytoplasmic translation. They are the stabilizing counterweight to ARE-directed deadenylation and decapping decay driven by TTP, KSRP, AUF1 and BRF1.

reading_1.theme: Protein glycosylation and nucleotide-sugar supply
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover N-glycan assembly and processing (dolichol-glucose, mannose trimming, hybrid/complex branching, LacNAc elongation, sialylation). This is the protein-glycan building arm, fed by nucleotide-sugar synthesis and Golgi transport, alongside O-glycan and blood-group glycan synthesis and the CDG disorders.

reading_2.theme: N-linked glycan processing and maturation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe mannose trimming, hybrid/complex N-glycan synthesis, antenna elongation and sialylation, framed here as the Golgi maturation of N-glycans whose eventual lysosomal breakdown appears in the additional set.
